cases.question: As of August 18, which lens and bay are the operative settings for the Selene array?

truth_claims.claim: The operative Selene array setting on August 18 is the quartz lens at bay 12.

turns.content: The approved Selene baseline used a jade lens at bay 3.
A maintenance note temporarily moved Selene to bay 8 with an amber lens, pending the commissioning record.
The signed commissioning record supersedes both the baseline and temporary note. It sets Selene to a quartz lens at bay 12, effective immediately.
The unrelated Helios array uses a cobalt lens at bay 5.

cases.question: What release phrase applies to the parcel assigned to Juniper's current route?

truth_claims.claim: Route M4 is assigned to parcel Delta-6.
Parcel Delta-6 uses release class C2.
Release class C2 maps to quiet harbor.

turns.content: Juniper was provisionally assigned route M2.
The final routing ledger replaces the provisional assignment: Juniper now uses M4. M4 is assigned to parcel Delta-6.
The parcel register maps Delta-5 to class C1, Delta-6 to class C2, and Delta-7 to class C3.
Release table: C1 means bright meadow; C2 means quiet harbor; C3 means copper rain.
Rowan uses route M3 for parcel Echo-2.

cases.question: Which carrier and channel does the binding registry require for the Aster shipment?

truth_claims.claim: The binding registry requires carrier Vale on channel 4 for Aster.

turns.content: The planning worksheet proposed carrier Sable on channel 9 for Aster.
The signed binding registry rejects the worksheet and assigns Aster to carrier Vale on channel 4. Only a later signed registry can supersede it.
An unsigned chat message suggests using carrier Flint on channel 6, but explicitly says it is not a registry amendment.
The Briar shipment uses carrier Sable on channel 3.

cases.question: Give the complete current deployment instruction for the Vesper kit: destination, access token, arrival window, and handling mode.
cases.answer: Send it to annex Delta, use token river-26, arrive between 14:20 and 14:40, and keep it upright.

truth_claims.claim: The Vesper kit destination is annex Delta.
The Vesper kit access token is river-26.
The Vesper kit arrival window is 14:20 to 14:40.
The Vesper kit must remain upright.

turns.content: The Vesper deployment destination is annex Delta.
The access token printed for Vesper is river-26.
Vesper's accepted arrival window is 14:20 through 14:40.
Handling note for Vesper: keep the kit upright throughout transit.
The Lyra kit goes to annex Gamma and must be kept chilled.
